title: Relative Clauses (Who, Which, Where)
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora sabes cómo conectar ideas y dar más información sobre personas, cosas y lugares.

parts.visual:
Las cláusulas relativas conectan dos ideas y dan información extra. 
WHO = Para personas (Quien/Que). Ej: He is the manager WHO hired me (Él es el gerente que me contrató). 
WHICH = Para cosas o animales (Cual/Que). Ej: The report WHICH I wrote is on your desk (El reporte que escribí está en tu escritorio).
parts.audio: Relative clauses connect two ideas. We use WHO for people. For example: He is the manager who hired me. We use WHICH for things. For example: The report which I wrote is on your desk.

parts.visual:
WHERE = Para lugares (Donde). Ej: This is the office WHERE we work (Esta es la oficina donde trabajamos). 
THAT = Puede reemplazar a WHO y WHICH en contextos informales. Ej: The email THAT I sent (El correo que envié).
parts.audio: We use WHERE for places. For example: This is the office where we work. THAT can replace WHO or WHICH in informal situations. For example: The email that I sent.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el pronombre relativo correcto (who, which, where, that).

questions.question: The man ____ called you is the CEO. (Quien/Que).
The laptop ____ I bought is very fast. (El cual/Que).
This is the room ____ we have our meetings. (Donde).
questions.explanation: 'The room' indica un lugar para realizar una acción, usamos 'where'.

questions.question: I need an assistant ____ speaks Spanish. (Que).
Where is the file ____ I gave you yesterday? (Que/El cual).
London is the city ____ our company is based. (Donde).
The woman ____ is sitting there is the new director. (Quien/Que).
The contract ____ we signed is valid for one year. (Que/El cual).
questions.explanation: 'Contract' es cosa. Como 'which' no está en las opciones, usamos 'that'.

questions.question: I don't like restaurants ____ are too noisy. (Que/Los cuales).
questions.explanation: Aunque es un lugar, está actuando como sujeto de 'son ruidosos' (objetos/entidades), usamos 'which' o 'that'. ('where' se usa para 'donde ocurren cosas').

questions.question: This is the factory ____ we produce the cars. (Donde).
questions.explanation: 'Factory' es el lugar donde ocurre la acción, usamos 'where'.

questions.question: The employees ____ work here are very productive. (Que).
Can you send me the email ____ has the attachment? (Que/El cual).
He is the client ____ I told you about. (Del cual).
Is this the building ____ you work? (Donde).
The printer ____ is in the hall is broken. (Que/La cual).
Let's go to a cafe ____ has free Wi-Fi. (Que/El cual).
questions.explanation: Aquí 'cafe' actúa como cosa que 'tiene' Wi-Fi, usamos 'which' o 'that'. (No 'where has').

questions.question: Let's go to a cafe ____ we can talk quietly. (Donde).
The person ____ called you didn't leave a message. (Quien/Que).
I need a phone ____ takes good photos. (Que/El cual).
This is the town ____ I was born. (Donde).
The man ____ called is the boss. (Quien)
The file ____ I sent you. (El cual)
The office ____ I work. (Donde)
The woman ____ is talking. (Quien)
The computer ____ is on the desk. (La cual)
The city ____ we met. (Donde)
The employees ____ work here. (Quienes)
The meeting ____ was cancelled. (La cual)
The building ____ we are right now. (Donde)
The client ____ I saw yesterday. (Quien)
